description: Defines a LocationService class that manages location updates and authorization using CoreLocation. It provides methods for requesting current location, starting/stopping location updates, monitoring significant location changes, and handling authorization changes.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A final class managing location updates, authorization, and significant location change monitoring using CoreLocation. It conforms to NSObject, CLLocationManagerDelegate, and a custom LocationServiceCommon protocol.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Requests and ensures appropriate location authorization based on the specified mode.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Obtains the current location asynchronously, with optional parameters for accuracy, maximum age, and timeout.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Starts streaming location updates, returning an AsyncStream of CLLocation objects.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring significant location changes with a callback.
